name: Flywheel
description: A flywheel: a heavy rim carried on spokes, with the bore cut through the hub.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 80%, #000 80%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 80%, #000 80%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(44.5% 0.0%, 55.5% 0.0%, 55.5% 44.5%, 100.0% 44.5%, 100.0% 55.5%, 55.5% 55.5%, 55.5% 100.0%, 44.5% 100.0%, 44.5% 55.5%, 0.0% 55.5%, 0.0% 44.5%, 44.5% 44.5%); clip-path: polygon(44.5% 0.0%, 55.5% 0.0%, 55.5% 44.5%, 100.0% 44.5%, 100.0% 55.5%, 55.5% 55.5%, 55.5% 100.0%, 44.5% 100.0%, 44.5% 55.5%, 0.0% 55.5%, 0.0% 44.5%, 44.5% 44.5%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 30deg, 45deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 30deg, 45deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
